title: 9.1.2 | Bugfix Patch
body: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/5d8acef3dc165e974b692a30f90df6f47fd6441f.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]2V8[/b][/h2][list][*][p]The 2V8 event returns Tuesday, August 19th at 11:00 AM Eastern.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]PLAY WHILE YOU WAIT[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added the option to "Play While You Wait" to the 2v8 game mode.[/p][list][*][p]When queuing for a 2v8 Killer match, you'll receive the option to Play While You Wait.[/p][/*][*][p]This allows you (and a friend, if you'd like) to play a match of 2v8 as a Survivor while saving your place in the Killer queue.[/p][/*][*][p]After finishing this match, you will automatically return to your place in the Killer queue.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]THE LEGION UPDATE[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Innate Skills[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Reduced the duration of Feral Frenzy to 11s [i](was 12s)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced number of targets seen with Killer Instinct to 4 [i](was 7)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the number of hits needed to down a Survivor while in Feral Frenzy to 6 [i](was 7)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the bonus which extended the Killer Instinct detection radius beyond the Terror Radius.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]SHADOW CLASS UPDATE[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Team Skill[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Grants Undetectable for 60 seconds when sending a Survivor to the Cage of Corruption.[/p][/*][*][p]After the effect has elapsed, the ability will go on cooldown for 60 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]While this skill is on cooldown and you are within 32 meters of your teammate, gain 5% Haste and decrease cooldown by 25%.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]ESCAPIST CLASS UPDATE[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Team Skill [/b](adjustment):[/p][list][*][p]Escapist Team Skill is now activated by using Active Ability Button 2.[/p][/*][*][p]Range of Silent Rush ability has been increased to 12m ([i]was 8m[/i])[i].[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]GUIDE UPDATE[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Team Skill[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]When repairing, reveal the generator's aura and your aura to other Survivors.[/p][/*][*][p]Gain the ability to trap a generator. Charges over 90 seconds. Repairing generators can decrease the wait time. Stand next to a generator to install a trap. The trapped generator has a yellow aura visible to Survivors and will stun and blind a Killer who tries to damage it.[/p][/*][*][p]The trap is deactivated when triggered or after 120 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Open Exit Gates 15% faster and reveal your aura to other Survivors within 128 meters.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Unlockable Skill[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]After being caged, gain access to a listening device that automatically installs on a generator after completing 35% repair progress.[/p][/*][*][p]A bugged generator's yellow aura is visible to Survivors and reveals the Killer's aura when within 14 meters.[/p][/*][*][p]The device is deactivated when the generator is damaged or after 60 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]If a listening device is already installed on a generator when 35% repair progress is reached, install a new listening device that resets the 60 second countdown.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]NEW MAPS[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Treatment Theatre[/p][/*][*][p]The Shattered Square[/p][/*][*][p]Greenville Square[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]Content[/b][/h2][list][*][p]The Game map and the Jigsaw Piece offering have been re-enabled.[/p][/*][*][p]The Blood Rush perk has been re-enabled.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]SURVIVOR ITEM: FOG VIAL[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fog Vials now have a maximum of 2 charges.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability for The Singularity to teleport to Survivors he can see within the Fog Vial's fog.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][h3][b]Audio[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Michonne Grimes' running grunts were louder than other Survivors.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where background noise was heard when Michonne Grimes was hooked.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Xenomorph's Tail Strike Attack SFX would appear to be coming from its left side.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the "ready up" SFX would play when activating and deactivating perks in the Loadout.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Jonah Vasquez's "Long Swim" outfit would not play the appropriate footstep SFX.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Characters[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Lara Croft's "Forged Furs" torso would display gaps when mixed and matched with other leg customization items.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Unknown's "The Murder Weapon" was held incorrectly on the match results screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Unknown's "The Murder Weapon" was floating out of their hand on the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Animatronic's head would not follow the direction he was aiming.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Blind visual effect was delayed and only lasted a second when blinded as The Animatronic.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Executioner's Cage of Atonement was invisible from the Killer's point of view.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Environment/Maps[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue on PS4 where activating the Fog Vial on The Game map could make the screen go black or freeze the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in the Treatment Theatre map where The Executioner's Punishment of the Damned would not travel through viable walls and door frames.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Knight could not summon a Guard in multiple areas[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in the Greenville Square map where The Singularity's biopod could be placed outside of the fence.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Perks[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Exhaustion Perks could be reactivated by triggering Blood Rush while Exhausted.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Desperate Measures displayed the incorrect value in its description.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Wraith would remain cloaked when stunned by Head On or Blast Mine.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Platforms[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue on Switch and Switch 2 where generator regression sparks were hard to see.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Quests[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the amount of Bloodpoints awarded for completing a quest were not properly shown after abandoning a Trial.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some "Into the Fog" quest tooltips were missing images.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some quest tooltip images appeared smaller than intended.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Miscellaneous[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where bulk spending could fail if an old event item was present in the Bloodweb.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a server crash which could occur when a Survivor unlocked the secret chest in the Nostromo Wreckage map.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where vault auras were not revealed when using the Sharpened Flint add-on on the Scribbled Map.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Fog Vial would clip under the ground when dropped.[/p][/*][/list]
